title: OpenClaw for Developers: Autonomous Coding, GitHub PRs, and CI on Autopilot
summary: OpenClaw for developers who want bugs fixed, tests run, and PRs open while they sleep. Real autonomous coding workflows using GitHub, CI/CD, and Blink Claw.
body_markdown: Only if you have a server running. Self-hosted OpenClaw stops when your machine sleeps or shuts down. For true autonomous operation — catching 2am CI failures, triaging issues opened over the weekend — you need a hosted environment. Blink Claw runs your agent continuously in the cloud from about $45/month per agent, so it works whether your laptop is open, closed, or in a bag on a plane.
